title: Grafana
description: Grafana server health: HTTP errors and latency, datasource query errors (Prometheus/Loki/Tempo), logins, Grafana-managed alerting, database and resources. Curated from the official grafana-mixin (https://github.com/grafana/grafana/tree/main/grafana-mixin: 'Grafana Overview' dashboard and GrafanaRequestsFailing alert). The chart's 'Grafana Overview' (folder Kubernetes) stays as reference.

list.name: Firing alerts
list.expr: ALERTS{alertstate="firing", namespace="monitoring", alertname!="Watchdog", pod=~"grafana-.*"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing", job="grafana"} or ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname="GrafanaRequestsFailing"}
list.textFormat: Prometheus ALERTS series in state firing. See Alertmanager / alert rules for details.

list.name: Container restarts
list.textFormat: kube-state-metrics saw the restart counter change (crash, OOMKill or liveness failure).

list.name: Dashboard provisioning reloads
list.textFormat: The dashboard sidecar (k8s-sidecar) asked Grafana to reload provisioned dashboards after a ConfigMap change.

options.content:
**Grafana** (deployment `grafana`) is the UI for the whole lab: dashboards from ConfigMaps (k8s-sidecar),
datasources Prometheus / Loki / Tempo / Alertmanager, login through Keycloak (OIDC).

**Healthy**: Up, 5xx ratio ~0, request p99 well under 1s, datasource query errors 0, failed logins ~0.

**When red**
- *5xx ratio* above 50% for 5m fires the mixin alert GrafanaRequestsFailing (datasource proxy/query handlers are
  excluded on purpose: their errors usually come from the datasource, see the *Datasource queries* row).
- *Datasource query errors* → the backend (Prometheus, Loki, Tempo) is down or the query times out: open that
  service's dashboard.
- *Failed logins* → Keycloak/OIDC problems or someone guessing passwords.
- Pod logs: `kubectl --context k8s01 -n monitoring logs deploy/grafana -c grafana`.

Formulas: [grafana-mixin](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/tree/main/grafana-mixin); metric reference:
[Grafana internal metrics](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/latest/setup-grafana/set-up-grafana-monitoring/).

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

targets.expr: ALERTS{alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor", alertstate=~"firing|pending", namespace="monitoring", alertname!="Watchdog", pod=~"grafana-.*"} or ALERTS{alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor", alertstate=~"firing|pending", job="grafana"} or ALERTS{alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor", alertstate=~"firing|pending", alertname="GrafanaRequestsFailing"}

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Scrape health of Grafana (`up`).

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Running version (`grafana_build_info`, mixin 'Build Info').

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the Grafana process started.

panels.title: 5xx ratio (excl. datasource proxy)
panels.description: Share of HTTP responses with 5xx codes over 5 minutes, excluding datasource proxy/query handlers - the expression of mixin alert GrafanaRequestsFailing (warning above 50% for 5m). Yellow from 5% here to catch it earlier.

panels.title: Datasource query errors (1h)
panels.description: Backend datasource requests that did not end with status ok in the last hour (`grafana_plugin_request_total{status!="ok"}`): failed queries to Prometheus/Loki/Tempo.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Users active in the last 30 days (`grafana_stat_active_users`).

panels.title: Dashboards
panels.description: Dashboards stored in Grafana (`grafana_stat_totals_dashboard`, mixin 'Dashboards'). A drop after a sync means provisioned ConfigMaps disappeared.

panels.title: Failed logins (1h)
panels.description: Failed authentications in the last hour (`grafana_authn_authn_failed_authentication_total`).

panels.title: Requests / s by status
panels.description: HTTP requests per second by status code (mixin 'RPS' panel, `grafana_http_request_duration_seconds_count`). Most traffic here is health checks and the dashboard sidecar.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: p99, p50 and average request duration (mixin 'Request Latency' panel, `grafana_http_request_duration_seconds` histogram). Dashboards feel slow above ~1s; long-running websocket (/api/live/ws) requests are excluded.

panels.title: 5xx by handler
panels.description: Server errors per handler (same expression family as GrafanaRequestsFailing, without the ratio). Tells which API is failing.

panels.title: Datasource requests by plugin / status
panels.description: Requests Grafana makes to datasources through backend plugins (`grafana_plugin_request_total`), by plugin (prometheus, loki, tempo...) and status. status != ok = the datasource returned an error or timed out.

panels.title: Datasource request latency (p99)
panels.description: p99 duration of datasource requests by plugin (`grafana_plugin_request_duration_seconds` histogram). This is how long panels wait for Prometheus/Loki/Tempo.

panels.title: Grafana-managed alerts by state
panels.description: Alert instances of Grafana-managed rules by state (`grafana_alerting_alerts`) and scheduled rules (`grafana_alerting_schedule_alert_rules`). The lab alerts with Prometheus rules; this is non-zero only if someone creates rules in the Grafana UI.

panels.title: Alert scheduler lag
panels.description: How far the Grafana alert scheduler is behind (`grafana_alerting_scheduler_behind_seconds`). Above the evaluation interval means rules are evaluated late.

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Successful and failed authentications (`grafana_authn_authn_successful_authentication_total`, `grafana_authn_authn_failed_authentication_total`) and successful logins.

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: Connections to Grafana's own database (SQLite on the pod volume): open, in use, and waits for a free connection (`grafana_database_conn_*`). Waits mean the DB is a bottleneck.

panels.title: Dashboard provisioning reloads
panels.description: Calls to /api/admin/provisioning/dashboards/reload by the dashboard sidecar (k8s-sidecar) after a ConfigMap with label grafana_dashboard changed. Non-2xx = the new JSON was not loaded.

panels.title: CPU (cores)
panels.description: CPU used by the container (cAdvisor `container_cpu_usage_seconds_total`, rate) against its request (kube-state-metrics). No CPU limit is set in this lab (requests only), so the container can burst; sustained use far above the request means the request should be raised so the scheduler accounts for it. Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set (what the kernel OOM-killer looks at) against the memory request and limit. The working set reaching the limit means an OOMKill (watch the restart annotation). Formula: kubernetes-mixin 'Compute Resources / Pod' dashboard (container_memory_working_set_bytes).
